message:
Upgrade server-side AI release notes, server Gemini key setup, landing showcase, and dark-mode contrast

- Replace client/procedural release-note fallbacks with authentic server-side Gemini AI generation in `supabase/functions/manage-account/index.ts`, categorizing changes into non-empty New Features, Fixes, Improvements, Features Requested by Users, Security Updates, and Other Changes.
- Add `coerceReleaseBulletText` and `coerceReleaseBulletList` across the Edge Function and `js/super-admin.js` (plus `[object Object]` sanitization) so nested AI JSON objects always render as detailed readable bullets.
- Add Super-Admin-only `gemini-key-status`, `save-gemini-key`, and `test-gemini-key` actions backed by `public.internal_webhook_config`, update endpoint routing to prioritize `generativelanguage.googleapis.com` for free-tier `AQ.`/`AIza...` keys, fail fast on `401`/`403`/`BILLING_DISABLED`, and wire inline **Configure API key** recovery in `super-admin.html`, `js/super-admin.js`, and `js/core.js`.
- Auto-generate `js/release-commits.json` during `scripts/supabase-migrate.mjs` sync and add explicit change detection plus empty-state dialog handling when no new updates have landed.
- Fix `.toast` and `.inline-error` text wrapping plus dark-mode arrow/contrast styling in `css/app.css`, update the interactive showcase/theme preview in `index.html`, `css/landing.css`, and `js/index.js`, align policy modal deep-linking in `login.html` and `js/auth.js`, and expand contract verification in `tests/contracts.test.mjs`.

Add settings theme switcher, payment channel icons, live announcement names, and AI release notes polish

- Add Light/Dark mode switcher inside Settings with readable contrast across dashboards, hero plates, and landing views
- Upgrade payout and payment dropdowns with GCash, Maya, Bank, and Cash icons and refine per-field formal name validation
- Keep announcement author display names synchronized live when users update their profile name
- Upgrade Write with AI release notes to rewrite fresh, user-focused updates and filter out internal developer details
- Remove square avatar container borders, enforce circular close/remove button geometry, and fix startup initialization stability

Add money input validation, zero-layout-shift wallet table, mobile-only drawer alerts, and workspace UI/UX skills

Money and wallet reconciliation inputs now validate numeric format, decimals, and maximum limits up to 999,999,999,999.99 via shared helpers in js/core.js (parseMoneyAmount, validateMoneyInput, and guardMoneyInput), preventing floating-point precision overflow and adding missing max attributes on record edit and savings calculator amount fields.

Wallet reconciliation in reports now locks desktop column widths with fixed table layout, top-aligned cells, tabular numerals, bounded variance pills, and a non-collapsing error slot in css/app.css and js/reports.js so textboxes never shift horizontally or vertically while typing or displaying inline errors.

Device and drawer notification prompts, banners, and tray dispatches in account.html and js/core.js are now scoped strictly to mobile clients so desktop PC users no longer see Phone & drawer alerts or Turn on prompts while mobile push and permission sync remain active.

Workspace AI UI/UX standards and design intelligence are added under AGENTS.md, .agents/skills/stable-input-ui, and the UI/UX Pro Max v2.5.0 skill suite under .agents/skills, with updated contract coverage in tests/contracts.test.mjs passing 104/104 on npm test.

Add background push notifications, formal name validation, discussion media attachments, and UI refinements

Record discussions now support lossless file, photo, and video attachments via signed upload and view URLs (migration 061), track read state so unread count badges clear once opened (migration 062), fire replaceable comment notifications (migration 060), and always expose the Discuss button on contribution records including confirmed and void entries.
Closed-app notifications are enabled through VAPID Web Push delivery with the send-push Edge Function and push subscriptions schema (migration 063, sw.js), alongside native Android background sync via NotificationSyncService, NotificationSyncWorker, BackgroundNotificationsPlugin, and NotificationPollReceiver. Permission handling now checks both OS and browser states live, provides Android settings shortcuts and unblock instructions with recheck support, and uses clear On, Turn on, and Blocked labels.
Account and form workflows now enforce formal name capitalization with live validation across signup, account, member, treasurer, and administrator forms, and require optional-name link invites to complete their name immediately after sign-in (migration 064, manage-account). Additional UI refinements hide the excess carry-over toggle unless entered payments exceed the monthly due, restrict the ADMIN badge to group contexts, align the sidebar Sign out button, and remove the redundant green progress bar under Collected this month. All updates are covered by tests/contracts.test.mjs with 103/103 passing on npm test.
